articles.title: India cuts windfall tax on exports of petrol, diesel, aviation fuel
articles.titleEn: India cuts windfall tax on exports of petrol, diesel, aviation fuel
articles.summary: India has reduced windfall taxes on petrol, diesel, and aviation fuel exports. The duty on diesel exports is now 24 rupees per litre, while petrol duty is zero. Aviation turbine fuel exports will now face a 19.5 rupee per litre tax. These levies were first imposed in July 2022 and reintroduced in March 2026. India revises these export taxes every fortnight based on global oil prices.

India revises these export taxes every fortnight based on global oil prices.
